chapters.1.lds: The selected Church lesson joins Jude's warning images with prayer and compassion. Why does a warning about harmful teaching end with mercy and rescue?
chapters.1.summary: Jude, brother of James, writes to those who are called. He urges them to contend for the faith delivered to the saints. Certain people have crept in and turn God’s grace into license. He recalls Israel in the wilderness, the angels who left their place, and Sodom. He says the archangel Michael did not bring an abusive charge against the devil. He quotes a prophecy of Enoch about judgment. The readers should build themselves up in faith, pray, and wait for mercy. He ends with praise to God, who can keep them from stumbling.
